phases.name: The Rope Snaps
phases.say: (It drops, and lands on its feet, and is suddenly much closer.)

say.open: (Something hangs from the barrow's lintel by one foot, and smiles at you the wrong way up.)
say.death: (The rope is empty. It was always empty.)

bestiary.lore: The card of surrender and seeing differently: a shade that hangs between the worlds and turns the minds of those who look at it.
bestiary.weakness: Holy, heavily. Keep Sanity up and spread the Back.
bestiary.pattern: Every third turn a swinging dread down the Back; every other turn it turns a row upside down (Sanity, Confusion); the noose roots and silences the strongest. When the rope snaps the dread comes every other turn.
